subject.title: Add missing message channel admin subcommands

question: Should the local CLI expose Discord `message channel create|edit|delete|move` under the existing local-operator trust model and Discord `actions.channels` gate?
rationale: The code path already exists in the Discord plugin, but this PR turns create/edit/delete/move into direct CLI admin commands; automation should not decide that security boundary without maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Approve Existing Gate After Cleanup
options.body: Remove the changelog hunk, refresh the branch, and accept the current local CLI operator plus Discord `actions.channels` gate for all four commands.

options.title: Narrow The Command Surface
options.body: Expose only the subcommands maintainers are comfortable with now, such as create/edit, and update tests/docs to match.

options.title: Hold For Broader Admin Design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the broader channel creation authority model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/7661 is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve Existing Gate After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog hunk, refresh the branch, and accept the current local CLI operator plus Discord `actions.channels` gate for all four commands.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the highest-confidence recent routing candidate for the CLI/message docs surface and prior review context around this PR's boundary.
